description: Computes identity / similarity / gap statistics for a pairwise alignment (EMBOSS needle convention: every percentage is over the full alignment length, gap columns included; a column is a gap column when either row has '-'; residues compared case-insensitively). Similarity counts columns with a POSITIVE substitution score (BLAST positives): with matrix = BLOSUM62 | PAM250 | EDNAFULL the published residue-pair table is used, otherwise the scalar match/mismatch model (similarity = identity for match > 0 >= mismatch). Also returns positives and gapOpens (number of gap runs, BLAST gapopen) and the BLAST+ report values: blastPositives (identities + non-identical positives), the INTEGER percentages of the BLAST pairwise report (blastIdentityPercent, blastPositivesPercent, blastGapPercent: round half up, never 100 unless every column matches; NCBI GetPercentMatch), blastPident (tabular pident, 3 decimals) and blastReport (' Identities = a/L (p%), [Positives = b/L (q%),] Gaps = g/L (r%)'; Positives only with a protein matrix).

alignedSequence2.description: Aligned representation of sequence2 (must equal alignedSequence1.Length).

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix deciding which non-gap columns are similar: BLOSUM62, PAM250 (protein) or EDNAFULL (IUPAC DNA). Omit to use match/mismatch.

match.description: Scalar model (used when matrix is omitted): score of an identical pair; the pair is 'similar' iff this is > 0.

mismatch.description: Scalar model (used when matrix is omitted): score of a non-identical pair; the pair is 'similar' iff this is > 0.

gaps.description: Number of columns containing a gap in either sequence.

alignmentLength.description: Total alignment length including gap columns.

similarity.description: Percent similarity = positives / length * 100 (positive-score columns; identical columns whose own score is not positive, e.g. X/X in BLOSUM62, are not similar).

positives.description: Number of similar columns (BLAST positives / EMBOSS similarity count).

gapOpens.description: Number of gap runs (maximal '-' runs per row; BLAST tabular gapopen, Biopython open_gaps).

blastPositives.description: BLAST+ "Positives" count: identical columns plus non-identical columns with a positive substitution score (differs from positives only for identical pairs with a non-positive own score, e.g. X/X in BLOSUM62).

blastIdentityPercent.description: BLAST pairwise-report integer identity percentage: (int)(0.5 + 100*matches/length), 100 only if every column matches (NCBI GetPercentMatch).

blastPositivesPercent.description: BLAST integer positives percentage (same rounding rule) of blastPositives.

blastGapPercent.description: BLAST integer gaps percentage (same rounding rule) of gaps.

blastPident.description: BLAST tabular pident: 100*matches/length with three decimals.

blastReport.description: BLAST pairwise-report line ' Identities = a/L (p%), [Positives = b/L (q%),] Gaps = g/L (r%)'; Positives only with a protein matrix.

errors.message: Aligned sequence cannot be null or empty
Aligned sequences must have equal length
